message: The other day, during a particularly dramatic storm, I found myself glued to my phone, watching the family group chat light up like a Christmas tree. My kids were sharing their latest weather updates, complete with emojis, while I was just trying to remember where I put the extra flashlights. I chuckled at how fast they went from sharing warnings to debating whether we should try making a family recipe that required zero power—just in case. It struck me that even in a storm, it’s the little things that keep us grounded. How does your family keep the spirits high during a weather event?
